widgets_values: Boogu text to image at 1024x1024 through the base checkpoint: 25 steps at cfg 4.0, euler on the simple schedule, and no shift node because the 3.16 sampling shift ships inside the checkpoint. nodes.title: DGX Monarch | CogVideoX image to video
widgets_values: CogVideoX image to video at 1360x768, 45 frames (about 5.6 s at 8 fps), 50 steps at cfg 6.0. Point Load Image at your own first frame; the shipped filename is a placeholder, and Image Scale puts it on the latent canvas before the VAE sees it. Comfy ships no CogVideoX image node, so the bridge is the stock Instruct Pix To Pix Conditioning node: it encodes that one frame into both conditionings as the concat latent, and the model zero pads it to the length of the clip, as the vendor pipeline does. Its LATENT output stays unwired because it is one frame of zeros; Empty Hunyuan Latent Video builds the real canvas. An unwired image turns the render into text to video without an error. The 1.5 image to video card asks for the short side at 768 and the long side between 768 and 1360 and divisible by 16, and the latent frame count must be even because 1.5 patches two latent frames at once, so 45 frames is safe where the vendor's 81 is not; 77 and 80 are the longer safe lengths. This family pads every conditioning to a fixed 226 tokens, so cfg2 runs, but the auto table has no cfg2 row for it and picks uly2 at every resolution; for the CFG split, set the Init topology to cfg2 by hand. A CogVideoX 1.0-layout LoRA skips every key on a 1.5 checkpoint and raises no error, and the 1.0 files sit beside the 1.5 one under nearly the same name. The ComfyUI-layout BF16 I2V auto/Ulysses path is HW-scoped: cold and warm 45-frame renders completed, and the decoded one-step probe read NRMS 0.015932 against its local reference. Diffusers-layout loading and inpaint are not covered. VAE Decode returns an image batch; Save Image writes numbered frames. For a video file, use the stock Create Video and Save Video nodes. nodes.title: DGX Monarch | Flux 1 text to image
widgets_values: Flux 1 Dev text to image at 1024x1024, 20 steps at cfg 1.0, guidance embed 3.5. Flux 1 Dev is guidance distilled, so cfg stays at 1.0, and the Conditioning Zero Out negative gives the sampler an unconditional; it steers nothing. The Flux Guidance node sets prompt adherence, and its 3.5 is also what comfy applies when the graph has no such node. topology=auto runs this on one Spark and splits it across the pair once a cluster.toml is configured. At 1.05 MP no flux row of the auto table applies, so auto takes the generic uly2 fallback, the mode the 2026-08-11 Flux 1 Dev hardware run covers; on 2026-10-06 this graph's uly2 render matched the single-GPU output exactly. Sequence-parallel shards the text and the image stream separately. 1024x1024 and the shipped prompt both divide by two, so nothing pads. Since 2026-09-09 a stream that does not divide is padded, and its pad rows are excluded from every attention call instead of refused. The fidelity legs for that path ran on 2026-09-09 and passed: 1-step NRMS 0.006 on the padded image stream and 0.005 on the padded text stream, each against its own divisible companion. A prompt past the T5 floor of 256 tokens to an odd length pads the text stream, and an odd canvas such as 1448 square, 91 by 91 = 8281 rows, pads the image stream. For Flux 1 Schnell, point the loader at flux1-schnell.safetensors and set steps to 4, nothing else; the guidance value is then ignored, because that checkpoint carries no guidance embed. Schnell has its own record: on 2026-08-21 uly2 matched DP2 at 1-step NRMS 0.048 at 1024x1024 and its 4-step render passed; no padded Schnell render has been measured. XLabs-format LoRAs do not load here; use a converted release. The first render of a new model runs the identity gate, comparing the mesh with a stock single-GPU load before producing pixels. Allow a few minutes for proof renders. Later renders of the same combination skip the gate. nodes.title: DGX Monarch | FLUX.3 Klein Base image editing
widgets_values: FLUX.3 Klein Base image editing: about 1 MP, sized from the first reference, 25 steps, CFG 3.5, Euler and the simple scheduler, the vendor's ComfyUI settings. Try 50 steps for more detail, the model card's default; 25 and 50 both divide the sigma table ComfyUI builds, so the schedule stays on the vendor's. ComfyUI's native shift is the vendor's; add no shift node. Load your reference in Load Image. Scale Image to Total Pixels sizes it to about 1 MP, VAE Encode turns it into a latent, and Set Reference Latent adds it to both prompts; LatentMultiply at 0.0 hands the sampler an empty latent of the first reference's size, so the render takes its size from that reference, cropped to a multiple of 16. The vendor graph does the same with one Set Reference Multi Latent node in resize mode; these stock nodes carry the same arithmetic. Keep the scale node: an unscaled reference sizes the render from the source file with no limit. To add a reference, chain another Load Image, scale, encode and Set Reference Latent on both prompts. Cite references in the prompt as <ref_image_0>, <ref_image_1> and so on, in chain order, and describe the target as a full caption of the reference with the change folded in. The first reference's aspect decides the image grid, and an odd grid pads the image rows; a later reference can make the joint stream odd. Either pad renders on uly2 and single, and padded ring or hybrid refuses unless waived, so run edits on uly2 or single. The negative is an empty prompt carrying the same references, as the vendor's reference code builds it. The vendor's prompt guide asks for a full caption of about 100 to 350 words: medium and style first, then scene, lighting and camera, then each subject with its colors, materials and place in the frame. Describe what is there, not what is absent, and put any text to render in double quotes. The sample prompt is shorter than that guide asks; write a full caption for your own renders. The vendor's own graphs can run an optional prompt upsampler, qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler_int8_convrot.safetensors, which rewrites a short request into such a caption on the driver; its 9.7 GB is outside dgx-monarch's driver memory estimate. The stock Flux3 Layout Prompt node turns bounding boxes into prompt text. Either can feed CLIP Text Encode with no change to this graph. The INT8 ConvRot files pin an approximate attention kernel: single, cfg2 and dp2 ask for the Sol-Attn waiver, and uly2 drops the pin. This graph uses the BF16 files, which ask nothing. Auto picks Ulysses on a configured pair. In the 2026-10-15 hardware tests, uly2 edits with one reference stayed within the 0.10 one-step NRMS floor against stock ComfyUI on one GPU but were not identical; see docs/VALIDATION.md#evidence-flux-3-klein for the scope. Expects flux3_image_klein_bf16.safetensors in models/diffusion_models, qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors in models/text_encoders (CLIP type flux3) and flux2-vae.safetensors in models/vae; the vendor's vae/flux2-vae.safetensors holds the same weights in another key layout. Needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer on the driver and every Worker. The FLUX.3 Image Klein weights are under the FLUX Kommunity License v1.0; read its terms before commercial use. The Qwen3-VL encoder is Apache-2.0. The first render of a new model runs the identity gate, comparing the mesh with a stock single-GPU load before producing pixels. Allow a few minutes for proof renders. Later renders of the same combination skip the gate. widgets_values: MiniMax H3 with an image anchored partway through the video. Add Guide pins a still or a clip at any frame of the target, not only the first and last frames the image-to-video node reaches. Chain Add Guide nodes to anchor several frames; each takes the conditioning from the one before it. frame_idx counts pixel frames from the start, and a negative value counts back from the end. A multi-frame image batch is anchored as a clip and cropped to the model's legal clip lengths (5, 22, 39 and so on); a batch under 5 frames uses its first image only. nodes.title: DGX Monarch | MOSS-Image Base text to image
widgets_values: MOSS-Image Base text to image: 1024x1024, Euler and ComfyUI's normal scheduler at the vendor's 50 steps, CFG 3 and shift 5. Use at least 50 steps, and raise CFG toward 6 for a short prompt. The normal scheduler gives the sigmas the vendor's pipeline computes before it snaps them to its 1000 training steps, so it lands within 0.0005 of the vendor's schedule; simple lands up to 0.069 away at 50 steps and renders a different image from the same seed. A render here still does not reproduce the vendor's pipeline at the same seed, because that pipeline draws its own noise. ComfyUI's native shift of 5 is the vendor's; add no shift node. Model Sampling SD3 (DGX Monarch) samples at multiplier 1000, which would render noise on this model, so it refuses here. Skip Layer Guidance (DGX Monarch) drops block 22 (zero-based) from the negative pass on every step, the vendor's default; blocks 24 and 26 also help. Clear single_layers to turn it off: the image looks more realistic, but some details can collapse. cfg2 refuses while Skip Layer Guidance is on; clear single_layers to use it. The vendor recommends 1, 1.5 or 2 MP and reports 0.25 to 4 MP working, with sides in multiples of 16; the model trained at up to about 1 MP. The negative is the tag list the vendor's guide recommends; the model card's default is an empty negative. English works best and Chinese is supported. The vendor's pipeline reads up to 4096 tokens after its chat template; ComfyUI sets no such cap. Describe the finished image, put any text to render in double quotes, and use real line breaks where its lines should break. For tag prompts the guide's order is quality, score, meta, year, character, series, artist, then general tags, with @ before an artist name. Base has no post-training or CFG distillation, which makes it the usual target for LoRA training. Comfy-Org's own MOSS-Image graphs can rewrite a short request into a full caption with Text Generate on this same encoder; that step runs on the driver, and its memory is outside dgx-monarch's driver estimate. The INT8 ConvRot DiT files pin an approximate attention kernel on all 42 blocks: single, cfg2 and dp2 ask for the Sol-Attn waiver, and uly2 drops the pin. On uly2 they exactly match one GPU running the same file without its pins: the 2026-10-21 tests measured 0.027 to 0.036 one-step NRMS before that day's INT8 fix and an exact match after it. With any LoRA they refuse on every topology (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md #129). They also need comfy-kitchen 0.2.39 or newer. This graph uses the BF16 file, which asks nothing. Auto picks Ulysses on a configured pair. In the 2026-10-21 hardware tests, uly2 renders of this graph matched one GPU and stock ComfyUI exactly over all 50 steps on the simple scheduler and ran about 1.5 times as fast as one GPU with the first Spark capped at 2100 MHz; the normal scheduler was measured on the MOSS-Image text to image graph, where uly2 matched too. See docs/BENCHMARKS.md for the walls and docs/VALIDATION.md#evidence-moss-image-base for the scope. ring2 is measured, not granted: without a LoRA it stayed within the 0.10 one-step NRMS floor of one GPU without matching it, a stream with an odd row count asks for the ring-pad waiver first, and ring2 with a LoRA failed its first-use gate, so that pair is not supported.
